answer_1.quote: We draw a large number of excerpts generated by each strategy and train a family of BERT-based binary classifiers to label text excerpts as human-written or machine-generated.
datasets: Web text from GPT-2 training distribution

answer_2.quote: We find large differences in human rater and classifier accuracy depending on the decoding strategy employed and length of the generated sequences.

answer_4.quote: The human evaluation task is framed similarly to the automatic one. We ask the raters to decide whether a passage of text was written by a human or by a computer algorithm.
answer_4.guideline: Raters choose between four options: 'definitely' or 'possibly' machine-generated and 'definitely' or 'possibly' human-written.
